subject: Mathematics
title: Inverse Trigonometric Functions
summary: Trigonometric functions one-one nahi hain, isliye unke inverse restricted intervals par define hote hain jinhe principal value branches kehte hain.
sin⁻¹x aur tan⁻¹x ki values [−π/2, π/2] mein (tan⁻¹ ke liye open); cos⁻¹x aur cot⁻¹x ki [0, π] mein. Har ek ka domain aur range bilkul theek yaad rakho.
Key identities: sin⁻¹x + cos⁻¹x = π/2, tan⁻¹x + tan⁻¹y = tan⁻¹((x + y)/(1 − xy)) jab xy < 1, aur 2tan⁻¹x wale conversions.
Zyadatar JEE sawal principal branch ke bahar sin⁻¹(sin x) type expressions test karte hain — graph banao ya π se shift karo.

formulas.name: Negative arguments
formulas.formula: sin⁻¹(−x) = −sin⁻¹x;  tan⁻¹(−x) = −tan⁻¹x;  cosec⁻¹(−x) = −cosec⁻¹x;  cos⁻¹(−x) = π − cos⁻¹x;  cot⁻¹(−x) = π − cot⁻¹x;  sec⁻¹(−x) = π − sec⁻¹x

formulas.name: Complementary pairs
formulas.formula: sin⁻¹x + cos⁻¹x = π/2;  tan⁻¹x + cot⁻¹x = π/2;  sec⁻¹x + cosec⁻¹x = π/2

formulas.name: Reciprocal relations
formulas.formula: sin⁻¹(1/x) = cosec⁻¹x;  cos⁻¹(1/x) = sec⁻¹x;  tan⁻¹(1/x) = cot⁻¹x (x > 0), = cot⁻¹x − π (x < 0)

formulas.name: Sum of tan⁻¹
formulas.formula: tan⁻¹x + tan⁻¹y = tan⁻¹((x + y)/(1 − xy)) if xy < 1;  = π + tan⁻¹((x + y)/(1 − xy)) if x, y > 0 and xy > 1
formulas.mistake: Plain formula lagaane se pehle xy < 1 check karo.

formulas.name: sin⁻¹(sin x) outside branch
formulas.formula: sin⁻¹(sin x) = x on [−π/2, π/2];  = π − x on [π/2, 3π/2];  = x − 2π on [3π/2, 5π/2]

formulas.name: cos⁻¹(cos x) outside branch
formulas.formula: cos⁻¹(cos x) = x on [0, π];  = 2π − x on [π, 2π]
formulas.when: Graph origin se shuru hone wala zig-zag.

formulas.name: Converting one function to another
formulas.formula: sin⁻¹x = cos⁻¹√(1 − x²) = tan⁻¹(x/√(1 − x²)) for 0 ≤ x < 1
formulas.when: Right triangle banao: opposite x, hypotenuse 1.

examples.title: Principal value
examples.solution: 150°, [−90°, 90°] ke bahar hai; sin 150° = sin 30°, isliye answer 30° = π/6 (computed 30°).

examples.title: Branch ke bahar
examples.solution: 4π/3, [π/2, 3π/2] mein hai, isliye sin⁻¹(sin x) = π − x = π − 4π/3 = −π/3.

examples.title: Sum π ke barabar
examples.solution: tan⁻¹2 + tan⁻¹3 = π + tan⁻¹((2 + 3)/(1 − 6)) = π + tan⁻¹(−1) = π − π/4 (kyunki xy > 1). tan⁻¹1 = π/4 jodne par π.

examples.title: Telescoping sum
examples.problem: Σ (r = 1 se n) tan⁻¹(1/(1 + r + r²)) nikalo.
examples.solution: Har term = tan⁻¹(r + 1) − tan⁻¹r, isliye sum telescope hokar tan⁻¹(n + 1) − tan⁻¹1 = tan⁻¹(n + 1) − π/4.

topics.title: Why branches are needed
topics.explain: Function ka inverse tabhi hota hai jab wo one-one aur onto ho. sin x ko [−π/2, π/2] tak restrict karne se wo [−1, 1] par bijection ban jaata hai; [π/2, 3π/2] jaisi doosri branches bhi sambhav hain par principal branch standard hai.

topics.title: Graphs
topics.explain: y = sin⁻¹x (−1, −π/2) se (1, π/2) tak badhta hai; y = cos⁻¹x (−1, π) se (1, 0) tak girta hai; y = tan⁻¹x ke horizontal asymptotes y = ±π/2. f⁻¹ ka graph y = x mein f ka reflection hai.

topics.title: sin(sin⁻¹x) vs sin⁻¹(sin x)
topics.explain: sin(sin⁻¹x) = x, [−1, 1] ke har x ke liye (domain mein hamesha sach). sin⁻¹(sin x) = x sirf tab jab x principal branch mein ho.

topics.title: Substitution technique
topics.explain: √(1 − x²), (1 − x²)/(1 + x²), 2x/(1 − x²) jaise expressions x = sin θ, cos θ ya tan θ ka ishaara dete hain; simplify karke waapas badlo, branch ka dhyan rakhte hue.

topics.title: Solving equations
topics.explain: Sab kuch ek inverse function mein badlo, identities use karo, phir dono taraf sin, cos ya tan lo. Aakhri answers domain mein hain ya nahi, hamesha check karo.

topics.title: Common traps
topics.explain: tan⁻¹x + tan⁻¹(1/x) = π/2 sirf x > 0 ke liye (x < 0 ke liye −π/2). cos⁻¹x kabhi negative nahi. |x| < 1 ke liye sec⁻¹ aur cosec⁻¹ undefined. sin⁻¹x ko 1/sin x likhna galat hai — ye inverse hai, reciprocal nahi.

ratta: sin⁻¹, tan⁻¹ → [−π/2, π/2];  cos⁻¹, cot⁻¹ → [0, π].
tan⁻¹x + tan⁻¹y = tan⁻¹((x + y)/(1 − xy)), xy < 1.
